# Embedding Cost Estimator - Project Setup Instructions

Full-stack application for visualizing how prompts convert to embeddings, token counts, and cost estimation across multiple embedding services.

## Project Overview
- **Frontend**: React SPA with real-time token counting and cost visualization
- **Backend**: Node.js/Express API for embedding simulation and pricing calculations
- **Features**: Support for OpenAI, Cohere, and other embedding models with dynamic cost calculation

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
- [ ] Scaffold Backend Project
- [ ] Scaffold Frontend Project  
- [ ] Install Dependencies
- [ ] Create Core Components
- [ ] Configure Development Environment
- [ ] Test Application
- [ ] Prepare for Deployment

## Development Commands
```bash
# Backend
cd backend && npm install && npm run dev

# Frontend
cd frontend && npm install && npm start
```
